caption: The 3×3 patch has a bright centre 20 on a 10 background. Its 4-neighbour Laplacian is -40, so g = f - ∇²f raises the centre to 60; the 8-neighbour Laplacian is -80 and gives 100, unsharp gives 32 and high-boost gives 46.

spec.title: Worked example: sharpening a bright spot
spec.aria: A 3 by 3 patch of 10s with a centre 20, then rows for the 4-neighbour Laplacian -40 with g = 60, the 8-neighbour Laplacian -80 with g = 100, and unsharp 32 with high-boost 46.
